description: This file implements a plugin for the WPEFramework platform, specifically a StateObserver plugin that manages device state properties, handles events via IARM, and provides JSON-RPC interfaces for property access and notifications.

classes.name: StateObserver
classes.description: A plugin class that manages device state properties, handles system events, and provides JSON-RPC interfaces for property access and notifications.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the plugin, sets up IARM event handlers.

methods.name: Deinitialize
methods.description: Deinitializes the plugin, removes IARM event handlers.

methods.name: getRegisteredPropertyNames
methods.description: Returns the list of registered property names.

methods.name: getApiVersionNumber
methods.description: Returns the current API version number.

methods.name: getValues
methods.description: Retrieves values for specified device properties.

methods.name: getVal
methods.description: Uses IARM to get current system states for properties.

methods.name: registerListeners
methods.description: Registers property names for change notifications.

methods.name: unregisterListeners
methods.description: Unregisters property names from change notifications.

methods.name: onReportStateObserverEvents
methods.description: Event handler for system state change events via IARM.

methods.name: notify
methods.description: Sends notifications for registered property changes.

methods.name: setProp
methods.description: Sets property name, value, and error in a JSON object.
